lines.text: The ask bar wraps up to four lines, decisions sit above it, and a hold opens the ring in more places.
Settings is grouped under headings with one Notifications page, and its search finds Theme, Text size and Sign out.
Music's ratings, likes, playlists and play counts, and Podcasts' Up Next and speed, now follow you to every phone.
Study opens page 1 before the book finishes downloading; its search finds word forms and reads Spanish.
